data.body: Closure evidence: independent non-author review covered all 12 edited blocks at exact patch-set SHA 2ea356fa1bf63be7d9c8d1e829e71320a4c7a393; the immutable TSV receipt hashes to dde9b6bb19f36823bcb8563d72ea625c30196b2b15c5741497f24670c9c5508d and every semantic-preservation and bloat-removal verdict is PASS. Gerrit change 2883 reached LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with zero unresolved comments, then revision-scoped submit merged it as a46c50e063bb61e5f91e8684c10986f224d74d00. The merged commit is reachable from origin/main. Scoped checks and Gerrit CI provide verification; the full local suite was intentionally not run for this comment-only epic.
